parsed_profile_json.title: 7F.04 S3B CREEP DISTRESS
parsed_profile_json.reason_for_revision: Add Tech Advanced Gas Path (AGP) configuration, clarify overall recommendations, and update the TIL Affected Units List.
parsed_profile_json.purpose: Inform affected users of Stage 3 Bucket (S3B) and Stage 3 Shroud (S3S) modifications required for more reliable gas turbine operation. Failure to comply with these recommendations may result in a forced outage and/or increased part fallout during refurbishment.
parsed_profile_json.compliance_category_text: Alert - Failure to comply with the TIL could result in equipment damage or facility damage. Compliance is mandated within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: GE qualified NDT technician with tooling to perform FPI inspection
service_recommendation_line_items: Send all affected spare sets of S3Ss to a GE Vernova Service Center to receive the cooling air modification prior to installation and operation in a unit.
Send all affected S3Ss currently operating in a unit to a GE Vernova Service Center to receive the cooling air modification after completion of current tour.

After installation of modified S3Ss, complete configuration changes: resizing of ninth-stage extraction air orifice plate; unit control constant update; installation of updated inter-segment seals (laminate seals) on Stage 1 Shroud, Stage 2 Nozzle, Stage 2 Shroud, Stage 3 Nozzle, and Stage 3 Shroud.

Send applicable S3Bs (that have operated with affected (uncooled) S3Ss per Table 1) to a GE Vernova Service Center for evaluation and to receive the new repair process; repair eligibility is based on evaluation of creep accumulated in each individual S3B.
Operate 7F.04 Standard AGP parts repaired with the new process only with modified (cooled) S3Ss in their subsequent tour.
For 7F.04 Tech parts, assess eligibility for subsequent tour operation during the repair process; if eligible, operate only with the modified (cooled) S3S configuration.
Limit parts tagged 129T6911P0001 through P048 and 129T6911P0101 through P0108 to ONLY one tour after repair; after completion of one tour post-repair, scrap these parts.

For S3Bs previously refurbished before the new repair process was implemented, perform Fluorescent Penetrant inspection (FPI) every 4000 fired hours until removed from service; FPI should cover both the pressure and suction sides of the tip shroud fillets.
parsed_profile_json.completion_criteria_text: This TIL will be considered complete when all affected S3Bs and S3Ss have received their respective modifications or have been retired from service.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: Timing Code 4: At First Exposure of Component
Fluorescent Penetrant inspected (FPI) every 4000 fired hours until removed from service (for S3Bs previously refurbished before the new repair process was implemented).
parsed_profile_json.usage_counter_requirements_text: S3Bs previously refurbished before the new repair process was implemented should be Fluorescent Penetrant inspected (FPI) every 4000 fired hours until removed from service.
parsed_profile_json.frame_or_model_applicability_text: 7F gas turbines with the Standard, Tech, or Tech-Lite Advanced Gas Path (AGP) configurations installed or in inventory.
parsed_profile_json.hardware_or_part_configuration_text: Applies to affected S3S part numbers listed in Table 1 and S3Bs that have operated with affected (uncooled) S3Ss per Table 1. Recommendations apply regardless of which AGP configuration (e.g., Standard, Tech, Tech-Lite, etc.) is installed in a unit or that unit's hours/starts duty cycle. After installation of modified S3Ss, resizing of ninth-stage extraction air orifice plate, unit control constant update, and installation of updated inter-segment seals (laminate seals) on specified static components are required; a CM&U process is mandatory to implement these changes.
parsed_profile_json.serial_or_unit_applicability_text: 7F gas turbines with the Standard, Tech, or Tech-Lite Advanced Gas Path (AGP) configurations installed or in inventory.
parsed_profile_json.exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_: Laminate seals are not required for Stage 1 Nozzles.
parsed_profile_json.prerequisite_outage_or_inspection_contex: Timing Code - 4 (At First Exposure of Component). For S3Ss currently operating in a unit: send after completion of current tour. For spare sets: modify prior to installation and operation in a unit.

parsed_profile_json.configuration_summary: TIL applies to 7F gas turbines with Standard/Tech/Tech-Lite AGP configurations and affected S3S/S3B part populations. S3S cooling-air modification changes unit configuration and requires additional changes (orifice plate resizing, control constant update, laminate seals on specified static components). Post-repair S3B operation is constrained to use with modified (cooled) S3Ss; certain repaired part-number ranges are limited to one tour after repair then scrap.
severity_signals: Failure to comply with these recommendations may result in a forced outage
potential for some S3Bs to be scrapped due to accumulated creep
failure_consequences: unexpected unit performance or undesirable conditions (if partial completion of required configuration changes)
parsed_profile_json.risk_summary: Creep distress in S3B tip shroud fillet regions can progress from internal creep voids to surface cracks and potentially tip shroud liberation; modifications and repair processes are recommended to improve creep life and reduce forced-outage risk.

source_snippets.snippet: Inform affected users of Stage 3 Bucket (S3B) and Stage 3 Shroud (S3S) modifications required for more reliable gas turbine operation. Failure to comply with these recommendations may result in a forced outage and/or increased part fallout during refurbishment.
All affected spare sets of S3Ss should be sent to a GE Vernova Service Center to receive the cooling air modification prior to installation and operation in a unit.
All affected S3Ss currently operating in a unit should be sent to a GE Vernova Service Center to receive the cooling air modification after completion of current tour.

After installation of the modified S3Ss, the following configuration changes are needed to account for the addition of the S3S cooling air: 1.Resizing of ninth-stage extraction air orifice plate 2. Unit control constant update 3. Installation of updated inter-segment seals, i.e., laminate seals, on the following static components.
As part of this repair process, the amount of creep accumulated in each individual S3B will be evaluated to determine eligibility for this repair.
these S3Bs should be Fluorescent Penetrant inspected (FPI) every 4000 fired hours until removed from service.
The internal creep voids that were observed may propagate to the surface and initiate cracks that could eventually lead to tip shroud liberation.
This TIL will be considered complete when all affected S3Bs and S3Ss have received their respective modifications or have been retired from service.
